THE COMPANY

Built in Bangladesh.
Designed for everyday use.

OOYI is an independent technology company founded by Obayed and Yasin. It gives each product its own identity and the team a shared way of building.

OUR STORY

Starting with what we know

Local services in Hajiganj gave us a starting point: how do residents find a blood donor quickly, and how could neighborhood businesses coordinate delivery? These are different problems. Both reward spending time with the people doing the work.

CO-FOUNDER

Obayed

Full-stack web and mobile development.

CO-FOUNDER

Yasin

Co-founded OOYI with Obayed in Bangladesh.

HOW WE WORK

Small tests before bigger commitments

Our process gives each venture space to learn at its own pace.

01 /

Discover

Observe the workflow and identify where people lose time or context.

02 /

Prototype

Build one usable flow around the hardest part of the problem.

03 /

Pilot

Test with the people who would use it and document what changes.

04 /

Improve

Use those findings to decide what to fix and what to build next.
